bio: Stolkist carries a curse, but he wields it as a blessing: darkness flows through his veins as much as blood does. Only steadfast dedication keeps the corruption at bay, and so long as he remains in control, he can wield powers that few Stoneheart share. If only his fellow Dwarves would trust him.
